CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(PersonBirthdate), "미상", IF( PersonBirthdate > ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -120), "10대 미만", IF( PersonBirthdate > ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -240), "10대", IF( PersonBirthdate > ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -360), "20대", IF( PersonBirthdate > ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -480), "30대", IF( PersonBirthdate > ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -600), "40대", "50대 이상" ) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Age Group
